prompt: The client wants to know how serious a new rival is. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: The client still had the higher share in 2025
options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: The client's share has been stable
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: The client fell from 40% to 31%.

options.text: The rival is winning on price
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

options.text: The rival is gaining share fast at the client's expense
options.feedback: Right. The rival went from 10% to 23%; the client from 40% to 31%.

explanation: The rival is gaining share fast at the client's expense. The rival went from 10% to 23%; the client from 40% to 31%.

extras.proof: The rival went from 10% to 23%; the client from 40% to 31%.
